environment.description: Rails 7.0.4 application deployed on Kubernetes (EKS 1.27) with containers running as root (UID 0). Pod spec uses hostPath volume mount at /var/run/docker.sock for legacy monitoring sidecar. No PodSecurityPolicy or Pod Security Standards enforced. Container image based on ubuntu:22.04 with ImageMagick 6.9.11 installed. The application process runs with CAP_SYS_ADMIN capability. No seccomp profile applied. Ingress is a basic nginx-ingress with no WAF rules.
